---
title: Supervised Fine-Tuning
---

SearcherKit's SFT path converts agent trajectories into MS-Swift records and
launches `swift sft` from validated structured YAML. Keep trajectory generation,
conversion, training, serving, and evaluation as separate stages.

Install ms-swift according to [its manual](https://swift.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/GetStarted/SWIFT-installation.html). Install SearcherKit into the same training environment.

## Convert trajectories

```bash
searcher plugins convert \
  data/openseeker.jsonl \
  outputs/sft/ms_swift.jsonl
```

Use `--max-records` for a small validation set. Inspect several rows before
training and confirm that system, user, assistant, tool-call, and tool-result
messages are formatted correctly for the selected model template.

See `scripts/sft/sft_convert.sh` for conversion setting references.

## Configure MS-Swift

Edit `scripts/sft/sft_training.yaml`. Put semantic training choices in YAML:

- model and chat or agent template;
- loss scale and full or adapter training mode;
- maximum context and sequence-parallel settings;
- batch size, accumulation, learning rate, and epochs;
- DeepSpeed, checkpoint, logging, and reporting settings.

MS-Swift flags belong under `backend.extra_args`, check [MS-Swift Documentation](https://swift.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/Instruction/Command-line-parameters.html) for details

## Validate before launch

```bash
python -m searcherkit.training.sft \
  --config scripts/sft/sft_training.yaml \
  --dry-run
```

The dry run resolves the YAML and prints the generated `swift sft` command. Run
it in the same dedicated environment that contains MS-Swift, the intended CUDA
toolchain, and SearcherKit.

## Train

```bash
SFT_MODEL=/models/Qwen3-8B \
SFT_TRAIN_DATASET=outputs/sft/ms_swift.jsonl \
SFT_OUTPUT_DIR=outputs/sft/model \
bash scripts/sft/sft_train.sh
```

The wrapper prepares repository paths and CUDA library locations before calling
`python -m searcherkit.training.sft`. Treat its host-specific defaults as
overridable deployment settings, not portable model configuration.
